clusterTarget.description: Target cluster name — must match an existing cluster in Sovereign Core

instanceName.description: Name for the MongoDB instance — used as Helm release name and VM name prefix

diskImage.sourceContainerDisk.description: ContainerDisk image reference (registry/repo:tag). Built by securedimage/build.sh PUSH_CONTAINERDISK=true.

diskImage.pullSecret.description: Secret name in the namespace containing registry credentials for CDI image import (keys: accessKeyId, secretKey). Leave empty for unauthenticated registries.

diskImage.certConfigMap.description: ConfigMap name in the namespace containing the registry CA certificate (key: ca.crt). Leave empty to use cluster-wide trust bundle.

diskImage.storageClassName.description: StorageClass for the VM boot PVC. Use ocs-storagecluster-ceph-rbd-encrypted for compliance (mdb-enc-05).

vm.cpuCores.description: Number of vCPU cores allocated to each MongoDB VM

vm.memoryGi.description: Memory in GiB allocated to each MongoDB VM

mongodb.databaseName.description: Name of the application database to create

ha.enabled.description: Enable Replica Set HA mode. When true, replicaCount VMs are created and joined into a Replica Set.

ha.replicaCount.description: Number of Replica Set members. Must be odd (3 or 5 recommended). Only used when ha.enabled=true.

ha.replicaSetName.description: MongoDB Replica Set name. Must match across all members.

vip.enabled.description: Enable a VIP Service that routes only to the current RS primary (probe-gated). Requires ha.enabled=true.

vip.lb_type.description: VIP Service type: local (NodePort, dev/test) or external (LoadBalancer via MetalLB, production)

vip.nodePort.description: NodePort for VIP in local mode (30000-32767). Set 0 to auto-assign.

vip.metallbAddressPool.description: MetalLB IPAddressPool name. Required when vip.lb_type=external.

networkPolicy.enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy restricting MongoDB ingress/egress (mdb-net-02, mdb-net-04). Disable only if the cluster manages NetworkPolicies externally.

serviceAccount.enabled.description: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount + Role + RoleBinding for the MongoDB VM workload (mdb-rbac-03). Disable only if the namespace already provides a compliant dedicated SA.

compliance.enableEncryption.description: Enable WiredTiger encryption-at-rest in mongod.conf (mdb-enc-02). Requires MongoDB Enterprise Advanced licence. Pair with diskImage.storageClassName=ocs-*-encrypted for full coverage.

compliance.auditLog.enabled.description: Append auditLog block to mongod.conf at first-boot (mdb-aud-01, mdb-aud-02). Logs all auth decisions to compliance.auditLog.path.

compliance.auditLog.path.description: Filesystem path inside the VM for the JSON audit log.

compliance.auditLog.auditAuthorizationSu.description: Log all auth decisions including successes (required for mdb-aud-02).

logging.rsyslog.enabled.description: Write /etc/rsyslog.d/60-mongodb.conf and restart rsyslog at first-boot to enable log forwarding and file monitoring.

logging.rsyslog.forwarding.enabled.description: Forward MongoDB log lines to a remote syslog server over TCP/UDP.

logging.rsyslog.forwarding.host.description: Remote syslog server hostname or IP.
